# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Kernel DMA Protection

Blocks peripherals that can read directly from memory and do not support DMA remapping.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Microsoft Security Baseline (Windows 365 / Endpoint Security) via IntuneAdmin — value verified against Policy CSP DmaGuard/DeviceEnumerationPolicy. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Kernel_DMA_Protection.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Kernel_DMA_Protection.json) |

> The only real impact: an old dock, an external graphics card or a PCIe card without DMA remapping no longer works. The device itself keeps working normally — the peripheral is just not started. So test with the docks in the fleet before you assign broadly. Requires a restart to take effect, and does not apply to 1394, PCMCIA and ExpressCard devices.
